summary: Datadog logs retention tier upgrade (audit retention) + AWS Marketplace procurement
description:
Issue summary: The Security and Compliance team requested an extension of Datadog log retention for audit-critical log streams (Auth logs, Admin API, and Billing events) from 30 days to 365 days to meet upcoming regulatory review. Current plan is to procure a Datadog retention tier/ingestion commitment via AWS Marketplace to keep billing consolidated under our cloud vendor subscriptions.

Impact: Multiple teams (Security, Platform, Finance) require longer retention to complete audits and historical investigations. If not approved before the audit deadline (2026-04-10), Security will be unable to produce requested artifacts which may delay the audit and create compliance risk. Estimated delta cost: $14k–$22k USD/year depending on ingestion commitment and negotiated discount.

Request: Create purchase request, obtain quote from Datadog account team, route PO through AWS Marketplace (so charges appear on company cloud invoice), confirm entitlement assignment to the Redwood Datadog account, and update billing tags and budget code. Include rollback plan for overage and cutover verification steps.
purchase_details: Requested vendor: Datadog. Preferred procurement path: AWS Marketplace/Marketplace Private Offers. Expected license items: Logs retention package (365d) + 10% buffer on ingestion commitment. Estimated cost range: $14k-$22k/yr. Finance budget code: FIN-OBS-2026 (pending approval). Preferred billing owner: Platform (cost center: PLATOPS).
procurement_steps:
1) Request formal quote from Datadog AM (assigned: Claire Tan)
2) Confirm Marketplace SKU and private offer path with Datadog sales ops
3) Finance to approve budget code and issue PO
4) Submit PO to AWS Marketplace (procurement team) and accept private offer
5) Datadog to apply entitlement to RDW production org and add necessary teams to access
6) Platform to validate retention and log availability for sample streams
7) Close ticket and archive invoices
vendor_contacts: Datadog AM: Claire Tan <claire.tan@datadog.com> (primary); Datadog Sales Ops: marketplace@datadog.com; Redwood Finance procurement: finance-procure@redwood.com
budget_approval_status: Pending - Finance review requested 2026-03-03. Initial approval conditional on cost cap and tagging policy.
investigation_notes:
- Confirmed Datadog supports 365d retention via Logs Management add-on.
- Verified our current log ingestion patterns (Auth+Admin+Billing) estimate ~35 TB/month uncompressed; compression/ingestion filters may reduce billable volume.
- Platform recommended applying log-park/archival pipelines for low-value high-volume streams to reduce incremental cost.
- AWS Marketplace route preferred to unify billing; Datadog suggested a Marketplace Private Offer to preserve discount structure.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Unexpected spike in ingest could increase monthly charges beyond estimate. Mitigation: Apply ingestion-based filters and exclude debug-level logs; enable alerts for ingestion thresholds and set a cost cap via Platform autoscaling policies. Finance requested a hard cap clause in private offer or monthly notification.
validation_steps:
- After entitlement applied, Platform will run validation: query retention window for sample indices (Auth/Admin/Billing) and verify older documents (90d, 180d, 365d) are retrievable.
- Run spot check on Kibana/Dogweb dashboards and confirm historical queries return correct counts.
- Finance to confirm Marketplace invoice line items and cost-center tags.
resolution_notes: (to be filled after PO accepted) Expected final notes will include PO number, Marketplace order id, entitlement confirmation, date of cutover, and any follow-up tickets for retention tuning or archival flows.
comments: Maya Ortega (2026-03-02): Opening request on behalf of Security. Audit window requires 365d retention; asked for AWS Marketplace procurement to centralize billing.
Ethan Brooks (Procurement) (2026-03-03): Acknowledged. Submitted request to Datadog AM; asked for Marketplace SKU and Private Offer details. Requested formal quote and rate sheet.

Claire Tan (Datadog AM) (2026-03-04): Provided initial quote and proposed private offer. Suggested ingestion commitment of 40 TB/month with annual discount. Attached preliminary pricing spreadsheet in linked Confluence page.

Finance (Liam Patel) (2026-03-05): Marked as high priority. Need confirmation of final price cap and updated budget code. Asked for expected invoice cadence and Marketplace order ID for accounting reconciliation.

Platform (Jin Park) (2026-03-06): Noted we need a short validation window post-cutover. Will create a runbook for verification; recommended enabling log sampling to reduce billable volume immediately after cutover if ingestion spikes.
